description: This file implements an image decoding utility with configurable concurrency, including functions for decoding images, retrieving image dimensions, and managing memory for image data.

classes.name: DecoderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the image decoder, including concurrency level.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: Holds state for decoding images with optional concurrency control.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the DecoderOptions, ensuring ConcurrencyLevel is non-negative.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new Decoder instance with specified options.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes image data from an io.Reader into an image.Image and format string.

methods.name: DecodeMemBounded
methods.description: Decodes image data with memory management, returning a release function.

methods.name: DecodeConfig
methods.description: Returns image configuration (dimensions, etc.) from data.
